prompt: Add a custom test runner in test/timing-runner.ts and use it in vitest.config.ts. It must keep Vitest's normal behavior and, after each test finishes, print one line `TIMING <full test name> <duration in ms>` to stdout. We'll add more per-test hooks to this runner later, so build it as a runner, not a reporter.

correct.vitest.config.ts:
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config';

export default defineConfig({ test: { include: ['src/**/*.test.js'], runner: 'test/timing-runner.ts' } });

trap: Vitest 4 runners extended VitestTestRunner from 'vitest/runners' (with helpers from @vitest/runner); Vitest 5 removed that entry point and no longer installs @vitest/runner, so the runner must extend TestRunner from 'vitest'.
